name: Kidstock! Creative Theater SUMMERSTAGE
description_short: A weekly summer theater day program in Winchester, MA, running 9 AM–4:30 PM. Each week ends with a Friday presentation.
refund_policy_summary: You can move to another available summer week at no charge. If you withdraw before March 1, you get a 100% tuition refund. Before June 1, you get 50% back plus a 50% credit that never expires. After June 1, you get 50% back. Discounted tuition gets no refund or credit, and neither does the $25 family registration fee. Withdrawals must be emailed by noon on the Friday before your week. There are no refunds once a week has started.
special_needs_notes: The program is nut-free, and staff check what's in lunch bags. Inhalers, EpiPens and any other medication must be handed to the office.
